**Northbank Community Garden: Important Notice & Weekend Updates**

Please be advised that the north gate will be closed this Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. During this time, maintenance crews will be working to repair a leaking main water pipe. Please plan to use the east entrance to access the garden. 

Due to the scheduled maintenance, our highly anticipated spring seed swap has been rescheduled. It will now take place on Sunday at 11:00 am near the central pavilion. We hope you will join us then to trade seeds and share gardening tips with your neighbors. 

We are also looking for volunteers to help with general garden upkeep throughout the weekend. If you are able to pitch in, please reach out to our resident volunteer coordinator, Mina, to sign up for a shift. Volunteers are kindly asked to bring their own work gloves for safety, but all necessary gardening tools will be supplied on-site. 

Thank you for your cooperation, patience, and continued support in keeping Northbank Community Garden beautiful and running smoothly. We look forward to seeing you in the soil this weekend!

Hey gardeners, heads up about some dirt-shoveling drama this coming weekend. We’ve got a nagging leak in the main water pipe near the north gate, so we’re shutting that entrance down on Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm to get it patched up. Don't worry, you can still get in—just haul your wheelbarrows around to the east entrance instead. 

Now, because of all the ruckus, we’re pushing our big spring seed swap to Sunday at 11:00 am. Honestly, Sunday morning is a much better vibe for trading heirloom tomato seeds anyway, isn't it? 

If you’re coming out to help us dig, repair, or tidy up the beds during the Saturday chaos, please remember to bring your own work gloves. We’ve got plenty of shovels and tools ready to go, so you can leave yours at home. 

Mina is coordinating our volunteer crew for the day, so give her a shout when you arrive to find out where she needs you. Let’s get this pipe fixed so we can keep our veggies happy! See you out in the dirt.

Northbank community garden will close its north gate on Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. Plumbers are repairing a leaking water pipe near that entrance during these hours. Gardeners must use the east entrance to access the plots. 

Because of the work, the annual seed swap will now take place on Sunday at 11:00 am. Bring your surplus heirloom seeds to exchange at the central pavilion. 

We need volunteers to assist with clearing the path around the repair site once the pipe is fixed. Mina is coordinating the volunteer shifts for Saturday afternoon and Sunday morning. If you can help, contact Mina directly to sign up. 

Volunteers must bring their own work gloves for safety. The garden will supply all necessary shovels, rakes, and wheelbarrows. Thank you for your patience as we fix our irrigation system.

**Northbank Community Garden Notice: Weekend Updates**

The north gate will be closed this Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm to repair a leaking water pipe. Use the east entrance instead. 

Because of this work, the seed swap is moving to Sunday at 11:00 am. Bring your favorite seeds to trade and join the fun. 

We also need volunteers to help with the repair work and garden tasks. To lend a hand, please contact our resident coordinator, Mina. Volunteers must bring their own work gloves, but we will supply all the necessary tools. 

Thank you for your patience while we fix the leak. See you this weekend!
